name: Appartements Obwaller
beschreibung: Appartements Obwaller in Söll (Tyrol) consists of multiple comfortable holiday apartments. The accommodation enjoys a quiet setting on the outskirts of the village, with the town centre easily accessible on foot. Each apartment is furnished with a kitchen, a living area, and a private bathroom. Complimentary Wi-Fi and parking spaces are provided. Guests can also take advantage of a shared sauna area. In winter, the renowned SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area is close by, while summer invites hiking and a host of outdoor pursuits in the surroundings.
